action_items: None. iter150 spec (6 UI/UX changes) is fully implemented and verified: unread counters backend + hook + badges + mark-read, MentionsBell Discord-style header widget replacing floating MentionNotifier, LoginAuxButtons inside auth card with 5 views + active-label reflection, simulation-unauth guest flow with Dashboard redirect guard, InteractiveTutorial position fix (scroll+retry+auto-flip+clamp).
critical_code_review_comments: unread_routes.py correctly excludes self-authored messages via {"key_id": {"$ne": payload.key_id}} in group_messages count query, and DMs count only messages where to_key_id == payload.key_id (received-only). Verified by test_unread_counts_returns_count_when_new_messages which seeds a self-authored 'me' message and asserts it is NOT included in the count (expected 2 from alice+bob, got 2).
mark-read scope validation returns 400 for scope not in ('group','dm') — verified by test_mark_read_rejects_invalid_scope which asserts HTTPException(status_code=400).
conversation_read_state upsert pattern is correct: filter on (key_id, scope, conv_id) with $set last_read_ts + updated_at, upsert=True. Confirmed by test_mark_read_persists_state.

LoginAuxButtons.jsx exposes ALL 5 views (creator/user/modo/admin/guest) via VIEW_KEYS array, each with dynamic testid `login-view-opt-${key}`, and the picker label reads `Vue : ${currentMeta.short}` reactively from localStorage 'codeforge_view_mode' (+listener on 'codeforge:view-mode-changed').
MentionsBell.jsx uses bg-red-500 badge (Discord style), dispatches 'codeforge:open-conversation' event on click, and Dashboard.js listens for this event to open GroupChatsPanel via groupsOpen state.
Legacy /app/frontend/src/components/MentionNotifier.jsx has been deleted (test_old_mention_notifier_component_removed asserts !path.exists()). Clean removal.

GroupChatsPanel.jsx wires useUnreadCounts hook + UnreadBadge component + calls unread.markRead('group', g) on tab-click and unread.markRead('group', active) on group-open — verified in test_group_chats_panel_uses_unread_hook.

InteractiveTutorial.jsx position fix is comprehensive: scrollTargetIntoView() ensures target visible before positioning, maxAttempts retry loop for late-mounted elements, spaceTop/spaceBottom auto-flip when bubble would overflow, clamp() to keep bubble inside viewport margins.
Dashboard.js line ~62-90: correctly guards with isSimulationUnauth() AND !viewMode → navigate('/login') AND clears the flag afterward via setSimulationUnauth(false).

Simulation flag flow: LoginAuxButtons.jsx setSimulationUnauth(true) on 'Visite du compte' click; useDeviceIdentity.js exposes setSimulationUnauth + isSimulationUnauth backed by localStorage 'codeforge_simulation_unauth'==='1'. All 3 keys verified in pytest.
